principles: Keep customer, driver, and owner knowledge separated by role.
Use open-source and repo-owned knowledge before any external dependency.
Do not require API keys for customer chat.
Never claim a purchase improves giveaway odds.
Treat live customer records as operational memory, not public marketing copy.
Use owner-reviewed live route outcomes before turning observations into route rules.
Do not show seeded fake/sample customer, route, order, driver, or sales lead records in production UI.

deploymentLessons.problem: Vercel showed npm install/build failures while the repo was moving quickly.
deploymentLessons.lesson: Pin real package versions, avoid nonexistent exact versions, and keep build commands explicit.
deploymentLessons.rule: Use npm install --legacy-peer-deps and npm run build from main. Current build script uses next build --webpack.

deploymentLessons.problem: typescript@5.7.0 was pinned but does not exist as an npm release.
deploymentLessons.rule: Before pinning exact versions, confirm the package version exists.

deploymentLessons.problem: Next 16 defaults to Turbopack, while the app has webpack fallbacks for browser-only AI packages.
deploymentLessons.lesson: Use next build --webpack until the AI package path is migrated to a Turbopack-safe config.
deploymentLessons.rule: Do not remove --webpack without running a full production build.

deploymentLessons.problem: Vercel Hobby build rate limits can look like app failures.
deploymentLessons.lesson: If GitHub status target points to upgradeToPro=build-rate-limit, the repo may be healthy and Vercel is rate-limited.
deploymentLessons.rule: Check whether the target URL is a build-rate-limit page before changing code.

customer.tone: modern, helpful, concise, premium but practical
mustSay: Giveaway entry is free and no purchase is necessary when giveaway questions come up.
Cheesecake is an order bonus separate from giveaway odds.

blocked: owner profit reports unless explicitly present in driver context
claiming unreviewed data as final truth
mixing fake records with live records

ownerRules: Use the owner dashboard and live database as the operational source of truth.
Do not show seeded fake/sample records in production UI.
Review learning events before converting them into route policy.
Restock issues should block premium promises until reviewed.
Fuel and miles should inform route grouping, not override customer service needs.
Customer-facing chat should not expose internal economics or operational tools.
